## Highlights

- Send durable SMTP notifications for task outcomes, test messages and daemon health, with encrypted transport choices, write-only credentials and recipient-aware retries across CLI, desktop and remote administration.
- Author and inspect tasks, groups, schedules, notification policies and operational state through the expanded CLI; evaluate packaged commands with isolated Windows/WSL fixtures and structured after-action reports.
- Use the branded go-schedule.io website, searchable documentation and sourced release comparison, alongside reliability corrections for watchers, credential helpers, diagnostics and script payloads.
- Align desktop/build dependencies and Pages publishing actions; retain exact-source staging, candidate identity, checksums and the existing standing native-testing waiver.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.6.0/CHANGELOG.md#160---2026-10-22) for every change.
